items.period: Shuowen small-seal style; modern digital redraw uploaded 2018
items.caption: Modern redraw of 機 in Shuowen seal-script style, illustrating the traditional graph named in the dictionary analysis 从木幾聲.
items.alt: A modern line drawing of the seal-script form 機.
items.selection_reason: The file page directly identifies the graph and script style, gives source provenance to the Xiaoxuetang record, and states CC0 reuse. It illustrates the traditional graph’s seal-style form without implying an excavated artifact.
items.rights: CC0 1.0; the Wikimedia Commons page identifies the drawing as public domain and describes the Academia Sinica source glyph as CC0.

limitations.text: No specific Xiaoxuetang glyph record was retrieved for this entry in this run, so no database image is proposed. The chosen Commons image is a modern redraw; no claim is made that its exact strokes reproduce an excavated inscription.
